title: Add routines to register a bunch of report_message routines.
description:
Instead of having the same big table of routines in in all programs that
report errors to the command line, and a different big table in all
programs thar report errors with an alert box, have one routine to
register the command-line error report routines and another to regiser
the alert-box error report routines, and call those in the appropriate
programs.
